hypothesis: The first designated home game after at least three consecutive away games has a lower home win rate than consensus closing probability implies, relative to other home games.
motivation: Re-entry/travel workload after a multi-game road sequence may be incompletely priced. This is a schedule proxy, not measured travel, goalie confirmation or a rescue of failed NBA rest rules.
prior_inspection: Publisher season-wide aggregate outcomes and schema were visible; no NHL game rows or homecoming subgroup outcomes downloaded or inspected. NBA seasons were previously inspected and are not used.

source.license: Publisher labels CC BY4.0; retain attribution and upstream provenance/coverage caveats. No purchase or account.

population: 2025-26 regular season only. Stable team/event IDs and scheduled UTC starts. Postseason excluded.

outcome_blind_gates.invalid_required_input: abort whole screen; no silent row dropping

exposure.definition: For each designated home game, the team's immediately preceding three regular-season games were designated away, all three starts strictly before this game, oldest within14days, and prior start18to96hours before current start (inclusive). At least three prior games required. A longer away streak qualifies with same last-three rule.
exposure.controls: All other regular-season designated home games, including early-season insufficient-history home games. No rest-matched or cutoff variants.
exposure.timing: Only prior schedule positions/times determine exposure. Current/future scores, odds changes and future schedule never determine eligibility.

endpoint.name: difference_in_mean_home_win_residual
endpoint.contrast: treated mean residual minus control mean residual
endpoint.grading: Final scores including overtime/shootout, per publisher schema. Reject tied, negative or noninteger finals; verify moneyline_winner if provided. No sportsbook acceptance/settlement compatibility claim.
endpoint.secondary: Report treated/control counts,wins,mean probability,mean residual,Brier score and all exclusion/audit counts. No subgroup searches.

uncertainty.method: Circular four-week block bootstrap over all calendar weeks between first and last regular-season start; anchor Monday in America/New_York; preserve every game and exposure classification within week;20,000draws;seed20261103;percentile95%interval for contrast
uncertainty.dependence: Week blocks address local temporal dependence; same-team and cross-block dependence remain limitations. No independent-trial binomial interpretation.

decision.support_descriptive_lead: All gates pass, contrast<=-0.03 and upper95%bootstrap bound<0.
decision.otherwise: Not supported, or data-infeasible if pre-outcome gate fails. Retain failure and all original thresholds.
decision.promotion: Never publish picks/profitability from this screen. Requires independent-season replication and prospective decision-time paired executable prices, availability and exact rules.

variants: Exactly one fixed contrast; no alternative trip lengths,rest bands,teams,season filters or endpoints after inspection.
holdout: One descriptive season; no fitted model or train/test split. After inspection2025-26 is development evidence for this family.
costs: No per-book executable prices,fees,limits or quote times; do not compute ROI,CLV or price-specific future picks.
daily_slot: First substantial new statistical screen on2026-11-03Eastern if endpoint evaluation occurs; feasibility-only abort does not inspect outcomes.
